title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: Regularization techniques like L1 regularization can increase model bias because they simplify the model by reducing the number of features or the magnitude of coefficients.

title: Trade-off in Regularization
text: Regularization introduces a trade-off between bias and variance. While it can increase bias by simplifying the model, it often reduces variance, leading to better generalization on unseen data.

title: True or False: L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization typically increases model bias.
